title: zero-sized DefaultFileRegion leads to system stuck & high sys usage
body:
Originally described in this mailing list post: https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/netty/2gLgE_4q3Pc

Netty version: 4.0.23.Final
OS Kernel version: 3.10.53-56.140.amzn1.x86_64
OpenJDK version: java version "1.7.0_65" OpenJDK Runtime Environment (amzn-2.5.1.2.44.amzn1-x86_64 u65-b17)
Transport used: EpollEventLoopGroup / EpollServerSocketChannel

When we send a zero-sized DefaultFileRegion, the system becomes stuck with sys usage  ~ 90%. Perf shows that most of the time are spent in getting time:

```
   70.21%            java  [kernel.kallsyms]   [k] pvclock_clocksource_read                                       
                      |
                      --- pvclock_clocksource_read
                         |          
                         |--99.68%-- xen_clocksource_get_cycles
                         |          |          
                         |          |--85.42%-- ktime_get_ts
                         |          |          |          
                         |          |          |--67.81%-- posix_ktime_get_ts
                         |          |          |          SyS_clock_gettime
                         |          |          |          system_call_fastpath
                         |          |          |          |          
                         |          |          |          |--100.00%-- 0x7fffac1fe7d2
                         |          |          |          |          clock_gettime
                         |          |          |          |          |          
                         |          |          |          |          |--24.74%-- 0x7f9f9d4075d0
                         |          |          |          |          |          
                         |          |          |          |          |--24.59%-- 0x7f9f9d2cf6ab
                         |          |          |          |          |          
                         |          |          |          |          |--24.55%-- 0x7f9f9d415901
                         |          |          |          |          |          0x7f9ed9a04188
                         |          |          |          |          |          
                         |          |          |          |          |--24.19%-- 0x7f9f9d2cf803
                         |          |          |          |          |          
                         |          |          |          |          |--0.52%-- 0x7f9f9d42891f
                         |          |          |          |          |          0x7f9ed9561258
                         |          |          |          |           --1.40%-- [...]
                         |          |          |           --0.00%-- [...]
```

The code we had was something like this:

``` scala

final class ServerResponseEncoder extends MessageToMessageEncoder[ServerResponse] {
  override def encode(ctx: ChannelHandlerContext, in: ServerResponse, out: JList[Object]): Unit = {
    val body =  // some DefaultFileRegion
    val header =  // some bytes for the message header
    out.add(header)
    if (data.count > 0) {   // if I remove the size check and always add DefaultFileRegion to out, the problem manifests
       out.add(body)
    }
  }
```
